# Abhijeet Shinde - Web Developer
> Personal portfolio and blog of Abhijeet Shinde, a web developer specializing in backend architecture, DevOps, and scalable systems.

## Key Services
- Backend Development & Architecture
- DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
- Scalable Web Applications
- React & Next.js Development
